correctness.rationale: An explicit facet-permutation identity holds for all 16 centers. All 2^16 masks are classified and 2736 Hasse incidences checked per graph. A complete acyclic matching leaves 1 critical vertex, 1 critical edge and 56 critical triangles; exact signed integral Morse projection yields boundary coefficients 0 or ±2 with gcd precisely 2, independently reproduced for both graphs. Since a connected 2-dimensional Morse CW complex with one 0-cell and one 1-cell has all 2-cell attaching maps classified by winding number, Nielsen moves reduce the vector to (2,0,...,0), proving RP^2 wedge 55 two-spheres. Direct mod-2 and mod-3 homology checks corroborate but are not substituted for the integral proof. No extension beyond the two graphs is inferred.

value.rationale: The two nonisomorphic (16,6,2,2) strongly regular graphs are a canonical cospectral test pair. Their open-neighborhood complexes are identical whereas the previously calculated closed Čech and independence variants distinguish them. The novel exact integral low-dimensional computation supplies 2-primary first-homology torsion, the complete π1, the full homotopy type and a substantive 55-sphere count, directly addressing low-degree groups left unknown in the closest rook result. The pure five-dimensional complex is nonshellable as a structural consequence.
